title: Boruto
author: Kishimoto Masashi
Kodachi Ukyou
synopsis:
Kishimoto Masashi, Kodachi Ukyou ini bercerita tentang
Naruto was a young shinobi with an incorrigible knack for mischief. He achieved his dream to become the greatest ninja in the village and his face sits atop the Hokage monument. But this is not his story… A new generation of ninja are ready to take the stage, led by Naruto's own son, Boruto!Note: Includes the one-shot "Naruto: The Path Lit by the Full Moon".
